data.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves and updating the calculation methodology behind the provision for future claims handling expenses. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes, GBP 1,285.7k of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3622 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 0.2 million for the year ended 31 December 2023. This release was primarily driven by a refinement in the methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revisions to actuarial methodology and calculation of future claims handling expenses. The movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, while the report also noted a net release of GBP 1,285.7k due to these methodology changes.
raw_causal_phrases: refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves
revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin
updating the calculation methodology behind the provision for future claims handling expenses
data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 1,285.7k due to methodology changes. However, following instructions to prioritize gross triangle when available, the prior year development amount is calculated as a gross release of GBP 0.2m from the claims development triangle. The narrative text for the movement describes the net figure. The gross premium mix is derived from the 'Binding Authority contracts' section, as no regulatory segmental analysis was provided.
